name: phonology-features-web
description: Lint config for the web frontend. The runtime bundle is built by web/scripts/build.py and does NOT depend on npm; this file exists solely so npm/eslint can find a project root for the lint job. ``type: module`` matches how index.html loads the runtime: main.js is a ``<script type="module">`` whose import graph is web/js/. sw.js stays a classic script (it is registered without ``{ type: "module" }``).
